corrected_defect.summary: the J9 runner built its base env config through the hardened J1 builder with output_dir=None, which sets record_outputs False and save_outputs_on_close False and omits output_dir and output_prefix entirely (v26c_j1_collect.py:325-330). Each cell then added back only output_dir (v26c_j9_closed_loop.py:369), leaving both flags False, so osim_trj_cmc_like.close() never called save_results() (osim_trj_cmc_like.py:2048-2053) and the post-close requirement for sim_outputs (v26c_j9_closed_loop.py:916-917) could never be satisfied.
corrected_defect.class: instrumentation contradiction internal to the J9 runner
corrected_defect.not_in: the environment, the J1 builder, the actor, any production source, the FSM, the morphology corridor, the reward, the SEA or the C++ plugin

the_correction.principle: build the base with a REAL output root, exactly as J1, J3, J5 and J6 all do, and let every cell inherit the recording flags from that verified base.
the_correction.july_faithfulness: J1, J3, J5 and J6 were ALL produced with record_outputs True. Enabling recording RESTORES parity with the entire V26C closed-loop evidence base; the J9 attempt, with recording off, was the anomaly. This correction removes a deviation rather than introducing one.
the_correction.base_construction: v26c_j1_collect.build_full_env_config(cfg, output_dir=<root>) with a NON-NONE root, so the base carries record_outputs True, save_outputs_on_close True, output_dir and output_prefix
the_correction.fail_closed_verification: the runner verifies that record_outputs is exactly True, that save_outputs_on_close is exactly True and that output_prefix is present, and refuses otherwise BEFORE any environment is constructed
the_correction.per_cell_mutation: UNCHANGED from J9: each cell mutates only episode_start_offset_s and its own output_dir. The subset contract is preserved literally.
the_correction.output_prefix: INHERITED from the verified base and NEVER mutated per cell
the_correction.layout: the J9 per-cell layout is kept: <staging>/j9_cell_<ID>_sim_outputs. The environment consumes that exact final path; no further nesting is appended by the runner.

dynamics_neutrality.claim: recording is neutral with respect to the SIMULATED RESULT, not free of technical cost
dynamics_neutrality.evidence: simulation_runner.py:486-487 - the record flag gates exactly one thing, `if record: self._recorder.record(...)`, a buffer append that consumes state and writes none back. _disable_output_files (osim_trj_cmc_like.py:2202-2214) only clears save_* file flags. No policy, no seed and no dynamic environment field differs between the J9 and the J9R1 configuration.

residual_technical_risk.what: recording is NOT free: it accumulates per-step samples in memory for the whole 500-step episode and performs file I/O in save_results() at close. It therefore adds RAM cost and close-time I/O, and can affect wall-clock.
residual_technical_risk.concrete_exposure: the environment enforces a per-step wall timeout (step_wall_timeout_s, passed to runner.step_until at osim_trj_cmc_like.py:1855-1857). A slower machine or a loaded one could in principle trip a technical timeout that the recording-off configuration would not have tripped.
residual_technical_risk.not_a_scientific_risk: if it fires it is a TECHNICAL failure, fail-closed, committing nothing - never a behavioural result and never an inference about the actor.
residual_technical_risk.mitigation: this is the SAME recording mode already used by J1, J3, J5 and J6 on this machine, each of which completed 500 steps and wrote its sim_outputs without tripping any timeout. The risk is therefore measured by four prior runs, not assumed away.
residual_technical_risk.honest_limit: J9R1 runs six cells sequentially in one process, which J1/J3/J5/J6 did not. Cumulative memory across six recorded episodes is not covered by those precedents; each cell's recorder is rebuilt per environment, but this has not been measured.

preflight_sentinel.rule: the preflight builds its base against an INERT SENTINEL output root that must never be created
preflight_sentinel.proof: the preflight records the existence of the sentinel and of <sentinel>/sim_outputs BEFORE and AFTER building the base config, and refuses if either appeared
preflight_sentinel.why_it_is_safe: v26c_j1_collect.build_full_env_config only formats path strings; directory creation happens later, inside SimulationRunner.__init__, at environment construction time - which the preflight never reaches
preflight_sentinel.remains_inert: no heavy import, no environment constructed, reset or stepped, no output written
